what_it_does: This paper proposes a novel approach to detecting data races (when two threads access the same memory location simultaneously without proper synchronization) in C and Fortran programs using OpenMP parallelization. Instead of analyzing the original code, the system uses AI to translate programs to the Go language, then applies Go's built-in race detector, which uses dynamic instrumentation to catch races at runtime. The goal is to find more actual bugs than existing C/Fortran tools.
